sections.shortTitle: Colonization of Governemnt Lands Sindh Amendment Act 2011
sections.description:
Short title and Commencement

ACT XI OF 2012
ACT XI OF 2012
COLONIZATION OF GOVERNEMNT LANDS
(SINDH AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011
An Act to amend the Colonization of Government Lands Act, 1912,
in
its application to the Province
of Sindh.
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV,
12th June, 2012]
NO.PAS/Legis-B-27/2011,
dated 11-6-2012.---The Colonization of Government Lands (Sindh
Amendment) Bill, 2011 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 30th April, 2012 and assented to by the Governor
of Sindh on 5th June, 2012 is hereby published as an
Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it
is expedient to amend the Colonization of Government Lands Act, 1912, in its
application to the Province
of Sindh,
in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as
follows:---
1. Short title and
Commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Colonization of Government Lands (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2011.
(2) It shall come into force
at once.
